about_short_description.short_description: SuperAPI is an API gateway that makes APIs cacheable.

product.name: SuperAPI Gateway
product.description: An API gateway that caches API responses to reduce latency and improve response times by monitoring database changes and invalidating cache selectively.

product.name: Database Change Monitoring
product.description: A system that connects to the database replication stream to detect data changes in real-time for intelligent cache invalidation.

product.name: API Endpoint Configuration
product.description: A feature to define which API routes to cache and how they relate to database tables for precise cache management.

product.name: SuperAPI Metrics Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing real-time insights into API request rates, cache hit rates, latencies, and cache invalidation patterns.
